messages:
arjun_sales: Kicking off a POC with FutureProof (enterprise). Need to scope success criteria, timeline, model fit (context length + tool calling), and ask about pricing/discounts. Can we sync up here?
elaine_solutions: got it. quick Q — primary use case is long-doc Q&A + extractive rerank, right?
arjun_sales: yes, ingest 30–50 customer guides (avg 12k tokens each). main flows: answer generation, highlight extraction, and reranking search results. must hit enterprise security bar.
maria_devx: for long-doc Q&A we should target a 32k context model or chunk+rerank strategy. success metrics I'd propose: MRR improvement >= 15% for rerank, answer F1 >= 0.78 on our eval set, and no PII leakage in answers.
jess_ops: ops/security note — they require SOC2 + customer-managed KMS for Private deploy. Are they ok with a Private deployment or do they want Hosted with an IP allowlist?
arjun_sales: they prefer Private (VPC) but will consider Dedicated if timeline shorter.
elaine_solutions: POC timeline proposal: 6 weeks. Week1 ingest + access; W2 baseline with off-the-shelf model; W3 prompt tuning & tool-call wiring; W4 evals + rerank tuning; W5 perf/cost tuning (batching/quant); W6 handoff + exec demo. Thoughts?
tom.s: pricing touchpoint — we can offer 6-week reduced-rate Dedicated credits or Hosted usage credits. For Private, need enterprise pricing (min commit). I'll prep options once we confirm infra.
maria_devx: important model fit checks: tool calling (they want to call an internal search API + a document loader), embeddings dimensionality consistent with their vector DB (we prefer 1536 or 3072 — what do they run?). Also confirm rerank strategy: embeddings + lightweight neural reranker or full cross-attention reranker?
arjun_sales: they use Pinecone (1536). prefer embeddings for initial recall then rerank with small cross-attention cluster.
elaine_solutions: implementation notes: we can do embeddings with our hosted embed endpoints. For rerank we can either: 1) use embeddings + logistic/reranker; 2) run a cross-encoder on a Dedicated instance for top-K. Pros/cons in thread if useful.
maria_devx: eval harness: we'll ask them for 200 labeled Q&A pairs and 100 search queries with relevance labels. metrics: MRR, Recall@5, Exact Match, and latency p95. share eval template:
```
# eval config
queries: 100
q&a_pairs: 200
metrics: [MRR, Recall@5, EM, F1, latency_p95_ms]
pass_thresholds: {MRR: 0.15, F1: 0.78, latency_p95_ms: 500}
```
arjun_sales: perfect. i'll request datasets today. can we also include a small prompt suite for hallucination checks?
maria_devx: yes — include 30 adversarial prompts and a regression set for production parity. we'll run rouge/precision+human spot checks.
jess_ops: security questionnaire update — created ticket and assigned to FutureProof SRE. CI bot: see link.
ci-bot: Security questionnaire created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1123 (assigned to jess_ops).
tom.s: next steps from sales side: finalize infra preference (Private vs Dedicated), confirm commitment length for pricing, and get data access ETA. once i have that i can share cost scenarios.
elaine_solutions: owners: arjun -> customer liaison/data; jess -> security + infra; maria -> evals + model selection; me -> integration + prompt tuning. I'll schedule a 30m sync early next week.
arjun_sales: thanks all — i'll ping them for dataset access and confirm Pinecone index specs (dim 1536). aim to kick POC next Monday. :thumbsup:
